title: Too stressed to sleep
situation: You have received this e-mail from your English friend, Emma. She is studying for her exams and feels very stressed. Write a reply to her.
situationHu: Angol barátnőd, Emma, a vizsgák miatti stresszről panaszkodik; válaszolj neki, és adj tanácsokat.
stimulus:
Hi,
Sorry I haven't written for ages. I've got so many exams at the moment and I'm really stressed. I can't sleep well, I'm always tired and I never have time to see my friends. How do you deal with stress before exams? Have you got any tips?
Love,
Emma

points.text: say how you feel about Emma's problem and whether you have had similar experiences
describe what you do to relax before exams
give her two pieces of advice about sleep and free time
suggest something you could do together after her exams

usefulPhrases.en: I'm sorry to hear that you're so stressed.
I know exactly how you feel.
to go for a run / to listen to music
You should try to … / Why don't you …?
to take a short break every hour

checklistExtra: Tanácsadásnál változatos szerkezeteket használtam (should, why don't you, it's a good idea to)?
